# Generated by tools/codegen/gen.py. Do not edit by hand.
# Generated-code library: unicode tables, catalogs, codecs, self-test vectors.

file(GLOB VD_GEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp")

add_library(vd_gen STATIC ${VD_GEN_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(vd_gen PUBLIC
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

target_compile_features(vd_gen PUBLIC cxx_std_20)

if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(vd_gen PRIVATE /W3)
else()
  target_compile_options(vd_gen PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter)
endif()
